manual_review.comparability: Within each v2 pair, the same node-isolated FlashInfer policy applies to both arms. WildChat predates that setup change and retains explicit legacy coverage. Shared persistent compile caches and fixed OFF-then-ON order prevent causal interpretation of startup differences across datasets. Startup remains excluded from request-latency timing and is reported separately.
manual_review.eplb_evidence: Ordinary async launch log counts for WildChat, ShareGPT, InstructCoder, NuminaMath, LongBench are 3,3,2,3,1. LongBench sole ordinary launch is compatible with calibration. These counts are log entries, not transfer or normal-commit certificates; no tested rank-agreement/map-commit proof is available.
manual_review.error_ordering: No parsed error precedes a same-file intentional shutdown marker in any completed arm. ShareGPT ON, both InstructCoder arms, NuminaMath OFF, and both LongBench arms contain teardown errors after explicit shutdown. Every arm logs abort timeout=0 and force-killing; completion is not evidence of graceful shutdown or committed-state consistency. Error totals count log lines, not independent failures.

jit_phase_review.external: No recorded JIT warning is compatible with an external phase across any of the five completed pairs. Warning absence does not establish that every shape is warm or that all compile cost is instrumented.

instructcoder_off_calibration.implication: The OFF calibration includes an observed JIT event and must not be described as a fully warmed sustainable-capacity measurement. Both arms still receive the identical OFF-derived external calendar, preserving the common absolute-arrival comparison; the chosen nominal load can reflect this calibration overhead.

jit_phase_review.other_jit: All other recorded JIT warnings in the five pairs are compatible with smoke only. Log times have one-second precision; these observations do not measure compile duration.
